title: Indian Rupee gives back early gains, UN General Assembly is key event
summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens higher again versus the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday but later gives back its early gains. The USD/INR pair flattens at around 95.82 ahead of meeting between leaders from the United States (US) and Gulf nations regarding the energy supply through the Middle East.

title: British Pound: Oversold slide nears 1.3335 against US Dollar – UOB
summary: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann remain negative on GBP/USD after the pair eased to around 1.3370. They expect a test of last week’s low near 1.3335, though a sustained break below that level and the major 1.3300 support is seen as unlikely.
